name: Silent_FCM_Receiver
description: Detects broadcast receiver silently consuming FCM messages without user-visible notification. Play Services FCM abused as silent C2 by Anatsa, SharkBot.

detection.alert_condition: no notification posted within 2s AND payload contains command_key

name: DexClassLoader_Runtime_Code
description: Detects DexClassLoader loading DEX/APK from external storage or /data/local/tmp. Core dropper mechanism for Anatsa, SharkBot versioning droppers.

name: Samsung_Push_Outbound_C2
description: Detects anomalous outbound connections from Samsung Push Service to non-Samsung endpoints. Parallel C2 channel independent of FCM.

name: IME_Change_Event
description: Detects runtime IME change to non-default or newly installed input method. IME swap is a keylogger installation vector.

detection.alert_condition: new_ime NOT IN user_approved_ime_list OR new_ime installed < 24h ago

name: Accessibility_Service_Grant
description: Detects new accessibility service enabled. Highest-privilege UI abuse vector — overlay, gesture injection, screen reading, settings manipulation.

name: Overlay_Tapjacking_Detected
description: Detects TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY usage by non-system apps covering input fields. Used for credential phishing and tapjacking.

detection.alert_condition: calling_package NOT IN overlay_allowlist AND overlay_covers_input_field

name: MediaProjection_Capture_Start
description: Detects MediaProjection API session start. Remote-view RATs and stalkerware abuse MediaProjection for live screen streaming to C2.

name: Device_Admin_Grant
description: Detects Device Administrator privilege granted to non-MDM app. Abused by ransomware and stalkerware for persistence.

name: Notification_Access_Grant
description: Detects notification listener enabled for new package. Exposes OTP codes, 2FA tokens, message content from all apps.

name: ADB_Port_Open_5555
description: Detects TCP port 5555 in LISTEN state. Remote ADB is full-device takeover requiring no authentication on unpatched devices.

name: VNC_Port_Open_5900
description: Detects TCP port 5900 indicating VNC server active. Full graphical remote access used by commercial RATs.

name: Reverse_Shell_Port_4444
description: Detects outbound connection to port 4444 (Metasploit default). Indicates active exploitation or post-exploitation C2.

name: Suspicious_Port_7777_Outbound
description: Detects outbound port 7777 — common non-standard RAT and C2 port observed in S25 RAT hunt.

detection.alert_condition: outbound_port==7777 AND dest_ip NOT IN trusted_allowlist

name: Data_Drop_tmp_Directory
description: Detects file creation in /data/local/tmp. World-writable staging area for dropped payloads and exploit binaries.

name: Broadcast_Receiver_Persistence
description: Detects BOOT_COMPLETED receiver in non-system app. Tier 1 persistence — auto-start on reboot.

detection.alert_condition: manifest contains BOOT_COMPLETED receiver AND app NOT IN system_allowlist

name: Foreground_Service_Abuse
description: Detects foreground service with suppressed notification. Survives background kill — persistent beacon/C2 polling.

name: WorkManager_Persistent_Job
description: Detects WorkManager periodic job with short repeat interval and no user interaction requirement. Persistent background beacon scheduling.

name: MDM_Profile_Install
description: Detects MDM profile installation outside known enterprise solution. Rogue MDM enables full device control.

name: Fake_Play_Update_Page
description: Detects WebView rendering fake Play Store update UI. Antidot and Brokewell use fake Play overlays to trick users into granting accessibility.

detection.alert_condition: page_title CONTAINS play_update_keywords AND calling_package != com.android.vending

name: Play_Integrity_Spoof_Attempt
description: Detects Play Integrity bypass tools present alongside passing verdict — spoofed attestation.

name: CVE_2023_20963_WorkSource_Parcel
description: CVE-2023-20963: WorkSource parcel mismatch privilege escalation to system UID. Patched March 2023.

name: CVE_2023_21492_Kernel_Log_Leak
description: CVE-2023-21492: Samsung kernel log pointer leak enabling KASLR bypass on S-series devices.

name: CVE_2024_0044_Run_As_Escalation
description: CVE-2024-0044: run-as privilege escalation — arbitrary app data access via ADB or local malicious app.

name: CVE_2024_32896_Pixel_Firmware
description: CVE-2024-32896: Pixel firmware privilege escalation actively exploited. CISA KEV listed.

name: CVE_2024_29745_Fastboot_Vuln
description: CVE-2024-29745: Fastboot memory disclosure on Pixel enabling bootloader exploitation.

name: CVE_2023_4863_WebP_Heap
description: CVE-2023-4863: WebP heap buffer overflow zero-click via malicious image. Exploited by Pegasus variants.

name: CVE_2023_26083_Mali_GPU_Leak
description: CVE-2023-26083: Arm Mali GPU kernel driver memory leak enabling KASLR bypass on Exynos/Mali devices.

name: CVE_2024_53104_USB_Video_Overflow
description: CVE-2024-53104: Linux kernel USB Video Class OOB write. Physical USB access vector for Tier 3 compromise.

name: DNS_Tunneling_High_Entropy
description: Detects high Shannon entropy DNS subdomains indicating tunneling for C2 or exfiltration. Used by SUNBURST, OilRig, Decoy Dog.

name: DGA_Domain_Detection
description: Detects algorithmically generated domains. High entropy, low vowel ratio, high NXDOMAIN rate — botnet C2 resilience.

detection.alert_condition: domain_entropy > 3.8 AND vowel_ratio < 0.25 AND domain_age_days < 30 AND NXDOMAIN_rate > 0.6

name: DoH_Bypass_Detection
description: Detects DNS-over-HTTPS to non-approved resolvers bypassing network DNS monitoring and FortiGate inspection.

detection.alert_condition: dest_port=443 AND dest_ip IN known_doh_resolvers AND calling_package NOT IN approved_doh_apps

name: Fast_Flux_DNS_TTL
description: Detects domains with TTL < 60s and rapidly rotating IPs. Fast flux evades IP-based C2 blocking.

detection.alert_condition: ttl < 60 AND ip_change_count > 3 within 5min AND domain NOT IN cdn_allowlist

name: NXDOMAIN_Storm_DGA_Beacon
description: Detects high-volume NXDOMAIN responses from single process indicating DGA cycling beacon.

detection.alert_condition: NXDOMAIN_count > 20 per min from single UID AND domains share entropy pattern

name: FCM_Versioning_Dropper
description: Detects versioning dropper chain: FCM message with URL -> HTTP fetch -> file write -> DexClassLoader. Anatsa and SharkBot delivery.

name: Launcher_FCM_C2_Vector
description: Detects home launcher receiving FCM and initiating network connections. Launcher as covert C2 receive channel.

detection.alert_condition: receiving_package is LAUNCHER_CLASS AND action=FCM_RECEIVE AND followed_by NETWORK_CONNECT within 10s

name: SS7_Attack_2G_Downgrade
description: Detects forced 2G downgrade enabling SS7 interception and IMSI catcher attacks.

name: Rogue_BTS_Cell_Anomaly
description: Detects IMSI catcher/rogue BTS: unknown Cell ID, strong signal, 2G-only forcing.

detection.alert_condition: new_cell_id NOT IN learned_cell_db AND signal_strength > -60dbm AND network_type=2G

name: MMS_Zero_Click_Auto_Download
description: Detects MMS auto-download from unknown sender with multimedia. Zero-click Stagefright-class exploit vector.

detection.alert_condition: auto_retrieve=true AND sender NOT IN contacts AND content_type IN [video/mp4,image/webp,audio/3gpp]

name: SIM_Swap_Account_Alert
description: Detects ICCID or IMSI change without device reboot. SIM swap enables 2FA bypass and account takeover.

name: Screen_Record_Background
description: Detects screen recording from background when screen is off or locked. Stalkerware and RAT exfiltration vector.

name: Camera_Mic_Background_Access
description: Detects camera or microphone access from background process when screen is off. Surveillance indicator.

detection.alert_condition: screen_state=OFF AND calling_package NOT IN trusted_sensor_apps

name: Location_Exfil_High_Frequency
description: Detects high-frequency GPS polling from background app with outbound transmission. Over 1 reading/min from non-navigation app is stalkerware indicator.

detection.alert_condition: poll_rate > 1_per_min AND screen_state=OFF AND calling_package NOT IN navigation_allowlist

name: Contact_SMS_Exfil_Batch
description: Detects bulk read of contacts or SMS followed by outbound network transmission. Spyware initial staging pattern.

detection.alert_condition: provider IN [contacts,sms,call_log] AND row_count > 50 AND followed_by NETWORK_SEND within 30s

name: Clipboard_Monitor_Background
description: Detects clipboard read from background process. Harvests passwords, crypto addresses, OTP codes.

detection.alert_condition: screen_state=OFF OR app_in_background=true AND calling_package NOT IN approved_clipboard_apps

name: Keylogger_Accessibility_Input
description: Detects accessibility service reading TYPE_VIEW_TEXT_CHANGED at high rate — keylogging via accessibility API.

detection.alert_condition: event_type IN [TYPE_VIEW_TEXT_CHANGED,TYPE_VIEW_FOCUSED] AND rate > 5_per_sec AND source_package NOT IN approved_accessibility_apps

name: Package_Install_Unknown_Source
description: Detects APK sideload from non-Play Store source. Primary delivery vector for Android malware.

name: Network_Traffic_Cleartext_Credentials
description: Detects HTTP traffic containing credential patterns. Cleartext transmission enables network interception.

name: VPN_Always_On_Bypass
description: Detects traffic bypassing always-on VPN profile. Indicates VPN bypass exploit or split-tunnel misconfiguration.

detection.alert_condition: vpn_active=true AND traffic_interface NOT IN vpn_interfaces AND dest NOT IN local_bypass_allowlist

name: Root_Shell_Execution
description: Detects su binary execution with effective UID 0 from non-system process. Indicates privilege escalation exploit.

detection.alert_condition: process_name IN [su,sh,bash] AND parent_uid NOT IN system_uid_list AND effective_uid=0

name: Airplane_Mode_Remote_Toggle
description: Detects Airplane Mode toggled by non-system process. Used to disrupt network monitoring and isolate device from FortiGate visibility.

detection.alert_condition: calling_uid NOT IN system_uid_list AND NOT user_interactive_session

name: Safe_Mode_Persistence_Check
description: Detects unknown processes active in Safe Mode. Third-party apps disabled in Safe Mode — persistence here = Tier 3 system implant.

detection.alert_condition: safe_mode=true AND unknown_process_active NOT IN aosp_system_process_list

name: Crypto_Wallet_Address_Swap
description: Detects clipboard modification replacing crypto wallet addresses. Crypto clipper silently replaces address with attacker address.

detection.alert_condition: old_content matches crypto_address_pattern AND new_content matches crypto_address_pattern AND old_content != new_content AND calling_package != user_wallet_app

name: Exfil_Large_Upload_Anomaly
description: Detects large background upload to non-cloud-storage endpoint. Indicates bulk data exfiltration staging.

detection.alert_condition: outbound_bytes > 50MB in 5min AND screen_state=OFF AND dest NOT IN cloud_storage_allowlist

name: Settings_Remote_Manipulation
description: Detects batch settings changes by accessibility or background process without user interaction. Matches S25 RAT hunt remote settings manipulation pattern.

detection.alert_condition: change_count > 3 within 30s AND calling_uid NOT IN system_uid_list AND NOT user_interactive_session

name: Baseband_Airplane_Persistence
description: Detects cellular activity persisting after Airplane Mode enabled. Indicates Tier 4 baseband firmware implant or SIM STK bypassing OS radio control.

detection.alert_condition: cellular_active=true OR sms_send_event within 60s of airplane_mode=ON

name: WebRTC_STUN_NonBrowser_Outbound
description: Detects WebRTC or STUN outbound from non-browser process. RATs abuse WebRTC for P2P C2 to evade port detection.

name: Privileged_APK_Hash_Delta
description: SHA-256 mismatch on privileged APKs vs baseline. Silent APK swap is Tier 3 persistence.

name: Ghost_Package_Persistence
description: Uninstalled package retains data dir or is disabled outside OEM allowlist. Tier 1-2 persistence vector.

name: Knox_Warranty_Bit_Flip
description: Knox warranty bit tripped. Confirms root, unofficial flash, or Tier 3 system partition modification. Permanent indicator.

name: Play_Integrity_Verdict_Failure
description: Play Integrity verdict degraded. MEETS_BASIC_INTEGRITY false = rooted or tampered. Magisk/Shamiko present with passing verdict = spoofed attestation, escalate to CRITICAL.
